# Edworking

Edworking is a collaborative workspace for managing projects, tasks, files, messages, notifications, and time tracking.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/edworking/.

## Actions

- **Add Time Entry**: Record a duration against a task at a specified start time.
- **Create Task**: Create a named task in an Edworking project.
- **Delete Task**: Permanently delete one Edworking task.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Get one task with its project, state, assignees, and time entries.
- **List Folders** (read-only): List folders in an Edworking project, optionally restricted to children of a parent folder.
- **List Messages** (read-only): List Edworking's message/activity records for one project from a zero-based offset.
- **List Project States** (read-only): List the workflow states configured for an Edworking project for inspection.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List the Edworking projects available to the connected account, returning IDs needed by project-scoped tools.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): List tasks, optionally within one Edworking project, with concise status and tracking information.
- **Remove Time Entry**: Permanently remove one tracked-time entry by ID.
- **Send Message**: Irreversibly send a text message to an Edworking project.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task's name within its Edworking project.
